title: Welcome to MAIS: Getting Started Guide
content:
Welcome to MAIS (Management and Information System)!

This comprehensive guide will help you get started with the system.

## For Students

1. **Login**: Use your university email and password
2. **Dashboard**: View your schedule, grades, and announcements
3. **Student Studies**: Access your course enrollment and academic records
4. **Print Reports**: Generate transcripts and grade reports
5. **Surveys (Anketa)**: Provide feedback on courses and teachers

## For Teachers

1. **Dashboard**: Overview of your classes, students, and pending tasks
2. **Student Management**: View and manage student records
3. **Grade Management**: Enter and review grades
4. **Attendance Tracking**: Mark attendance for your classes
5. **Chat**: Communicate with students and colleagues
6. **Resources**: Manage course materials and equipment
7. **Surveys**: Create and send surveys to students

## Quick Tips

- Use Cmd/Ctrl+K to open the Command Palette for quick navigation
- Press 'g g' then 'a' to jump to Activities
- Press 'g g' then 'p' to go to your Profile
- Check the Notifications panel for important updates

## Getting Help

- Visit the Knowledge Base for detailed guides
- Run Diagnostics to troubleshoot issues
- Report bugs through the Bug Reporter
- Contact support at support@mais.sk

title: Grade Management: Complete Teacher Guide
content:
## Overview

The Grade Management system allows teachers to enter, edit, and review student grades efficiently.

## Accessing Grade Management

1. From Dashboard: Click "Grades" card or Quick Actions → Grades
2. From Command Palette: Cmd/Ctrl+K → "Open Grades"

## Entering Grades

### Step 1: Select Course and Class
- Use the filter dropdown to select your course
- Choose the specific class/group
- Select the assignment or exam

### Step 2: Enter Grades
- Click on a student row to enter their grade
- Grades are automatically validated (A-F scale or 0-100)
- Press Tab to move to the next student
- Press Enter to save

### Step 3: Review and Submit
- Review all grades for completeness
- Click "Submit Grades" to finalize
- Submitted grades are visible to students immediately

## Grading Scale

- **A** (90-100): Excellent
- **B** (80-89): Very Good
- **C** (70-79): Good
- **D** (60-69): Satisfactory
- **E** (50-59): Sufficient
- **F** (0-49): Fail

## Bulk Operations

- **Import from Excel**: Upload CSV file with student IDs and grades
- **Export to Excel**: Download gradebook for offline editing
- **Copy Previous Grades**: Duplicate grades from similar assignment

## Common Issues

**Q: Grades not saving?**
A: Check internet connection and ensure student ID is valid

**Q: Can I edit submitted grades?**
A: Yes, click on the grade and update. Changes are logged.

**Q: How to grade late submissions?**
A: Use the "Late" flag and apply late penalty if configured

## Best Practices

1. Enter grades within 7 days of assignment due date
2. Add comments for borderline grades
3. Use grade distribution charts to ensure fairness
4. Back up gradebook regularly using Export feature

## Related Features

- **Attendance Tracking**: Link attendance to participation grades
- **Assignments**: Create and manage assignments
- **Reports**: Generate grade reports and analytics

title: Attendance Tracking: How to Mark and Review Attendance
content:
## Introduction

The Attendance Tracking system helps teachers monitor student participation and generate attendance reports.

## Marking Attendance

### Quick Mark (During Class)

1. Navigate to Attendance Tracking page
2. Select today's date (default)
3. Choose your course and class group
4. Click "Take Attendance"
5. Mark each student:
   - ✅ **Present**: Student attended
   - ❌ **Absent**: Student did not attend
   - ⏰ **Late**: Student arrived late
   - 📝 **Excused**: Absent with valid reason

### Bulk Mark

- **Mark All Present**: Use when all students attended
- **Mark All Absent**: For cancelled classes (then excuse all)
- **Import from Scanner**: Upload attendance list from card scanner

## Editing Past Attendance

1. Select the date from calendar
2. Find the student
3. Click on their attendance status
4. Update and save
5. Add note explaining the change

## Attendance Reports

### Individual Student Report
- View attendance percentage per student
- See absence patterns (consecutive absences)
- Export to PDF for academic advisor

### Class Report
- Overall attendance rate
- Students with <75% attendance (at-risk)
- Trend analysis (improving/declining)

### Export Options
- **CSV**: For Excel analysis
- **PDF**: For printing and records
- **Email**: Send report to students or parents

## Attendance Policies

### University Policy
- Minimum 75% attendance required for exam eligibility
- 3 consecutive absences trigger advisor notification
- Excused absences don't count toward limit

### Setting Up Policies
1. Go to Course Settings → Attendance Policy
2. Set minimum required percentage
3. Configure notifications
4. Save

## Notifications

Automatic notifications sent when:
- Student falls below 80% attendance
- 3 consecutive absences recorded
- Student reaches 75% threshold

## Integration with Grades

- Link participation grade to attendance percentage
- Configure: Grade Management → Assignments → Participation
- Set formula: Attendance% × Weight

## Troubleshooting

**Problem**: Can't mark attendance for past dates
**Solution**: Use "Edit Past Attendance" mode, requires reason

**Problem**: Student marked twice
**Solution**: System prevents duplicates, check if multiple class groups

**Problem**: Attendance not syncing to mobile app
**Solution**: Refresh app, check internet connection

## Mobile App

- Mark attendance from phone/tablet
- Use QR code scanner for quick check-in
- Offline mode: Sync when back online

## Tips for Accuracy

1. Mark attendance at start of class (first 10 minutes)
2. Update late arrivals within 15 minutes
3. Add notes for unusual circumstances
4. Review and submit before end of class
5. Weekly review for corrections

title: Chat System: Messaging Students and Colleagues
content:
## Chat Features

The MAIS Chat system provides real-time communication between teachers, students, and staff.

## Starting a Conversation

### Individual Chat
1. Click "Chat" from Dashboard or Quick Actions
2. Click "New Chat" (+ icon)
3. Search for person by name or email
4. Type your message and press Enter

### Group Chat
1. New Chat → "Create Group"
2. Add participants (search by name)
3. Name your group (e.g., "CS101 - Group A")
4. Send first message

### Class-wide Announcements
1. Chat → Select Course
2. "Message All Students"
3. Type announcement
4. Click "Send to All"

## Message Features

### Rich Text
- **Bold**: Surround with `**text**`
- *Italic*: Surround with `*text*`
- `Code`: Surround with `` `code` ``
- Links: Paste URL, auto-detected

### Attachments
- Drag & drop files (max 25MB)
- Supported: PDF, DOC, XLSX, Images, ZIP
- Preview for images and PDFs

### Mentions
- Type `@` followed by name
- Person receives notification
- Useful in group chats

### Reactions
- Hover over message
- Click emoji icon
- Add thumbs up, checkmark, heart, etc.

## Notifications

### Desktop Notifications
- Enable in Profile → Settings → Notifications
- Get alerts for new messages
- Click to open chat

### Email Digest
- Daily summary of unread messages
- Configure in Settings
- Choose: Immediate, Hourly, Daily, Off

### Do Not Disturb (DND)
- Toggle DND in Profile
- Silences all chat notifications
- Shows "Offline" to others
- Good for meetings or focused work

## Chat Etiquette

### For Teachers
1. Respond to student messages within 24 hours
2. Use professional language
3. For sensitive topics, suggest office visit
4. Set office hours in chat status

### For Students
1. Be respectful and professional
2. Check syllabus before asking
3. Use clear subject lines in first message
4. Don't spam if no immediate reply

## Advanced Features

### Scheduled Messages
1. Type message
2. Click clock icon
3. Select date/time
4. Message sends automatically

### Message Templates
- Save common responses
- Quick replies for FAQs
- Edit in Settings → Chat → Templates

### Search Conversations
- Click search icon in chat
- Filter by person, date, keyword
- Export search results

## Privacy & Security

- All messages encrypted end-to-end
- Messages stored for 2 years, then deleted
- Report inappropriate messages: Click ... → Report
- Block users: Settings → Blocked Users

## Troubleshooting

**Messages not sending?**
- Check internet connection
- Try refreshing page
- Clear browser cache

**Not receiving notifications?**
- Check browser notification permissions
- Verify Settings → Notifications enabled
- Disable DND mode

**Can't find a chat?**
- Use Search feature
- Check "Archived" chats
- Verify person's name spelling

## Integration with Other Tools

- Link assignments in chat
- Share grade updates
- Send calendar invites for office hours
- Attach documents from Resources

title: Surveys (Anketa): Creating and Analyzing Student Feedback
content:
## Survey System Overview

Create surveys to collect student feedback on courses, teaching methods, and overall satisfaction.

## Creating a Survey

### Step 1: Basic Information
1. Navigate to Surveys (Anketa)
2. Click "Create New Survey"
3. Enter:
   - **Title**: Clear, descriptive (e.g., "CS101 Mid-Semester Feedback")
   - **Description**: Purpose and instructions
   - **Due Date**: When survey closes
   - **Anonymous**: Yes/No (recommended: Yes for honest feedback)

### Step 2: Target Audience
Choose who receives the survey:
- **All Students**: Everyone in the system
- **Specific Group**: Select class/group ID (e.g., "2-Bc-INF-D")
- **Individual Students**: Enter email addresses (comma-separated)
- **My Groups Only**: Filter shows only your classes
- **By Course**: Select course code
- **By Program/Faculty**: Broader targeting

### Step 3: Add Questions

**Question Types:**
- **Multiple Choice**: Select one option
- **Checkboxes**: Select multiple options
- **Rating Scale**: 1-5 stars or 1-10 scale
- **Text Response**: Short answer
- **Long Text**: Detailed feedback
- **Yes/No**: Simple binary choice

**Sample Questions:**
1. "How would you rate the course content?" (Rating Scale 1-5)
2. "What topics were most valuable?" (Checkboxes)
3. "What can be improved?" (Long Text)
4. "Would you recommend this course?" (Yes/No)

### Step 4: Settings
- **Required**: Students must complete to proceed
- **Randomize Questions**: Prevent bias
- **Show Results**: Make results public after closing
- **Send Reminder**: Auto-remind non-responders after 3 days

### Step 5: Review and Publish
- Preview survey as student
- Check question logic and flow
- Click "Publish" to make live
- Students receive notification

## Managing Responses

### Real-Time Monitoring
- View response count: "42/150 responses (28%)"
- See completion rate over time (chart)
- Identify non-responders

### Sending Reminders
1. Surveys → Select Survey → "Responses"
2. Filter "Not Responded"
3. Click "Send Reminder"
4. Customize message
5. Send

### Closing Survey Early
- If target responses reached
- Click "Close Survey"
- No new responses accepted
- Results immediately available

## Analyzing Results

### Summary Statistics
- Average rating per question
- Response distribution (bar charts)
- Most common answers
- Completion time average

### Detailed Analysis
- Export to Excel for deeper analysis
- Filter by demographics (if not anonymous)
- Compare across different groups
- Trend analysis (compare to previous semesters)

### Visualizations
- Bar charts for multiple choice
- Pie charts for yes/no
- Word clouds for text responses
- Time series for rating trends

### Export Options
- **PDF Report**: Summary with charts
- **Excel**: Raw data for analysis
- **CSV**: Import to other tools
- **PowerPoint**: Presentation-ready slides

## Best Practices

### Survey Design
1. Keep it short (5-10 questions max)
2. Mix question types
3. Start with easy questions
4. End with open-ended feedback
5. Avoid leading questions
6. Test survey before publishing

### Timing
- Mid-semester: Identify issues early
- End-of-semester: Overall assessment
- After major project: Specific feedback
- Before course redesign: Student input

### Response Rates
- Target: >70% response rate
- Incentivize: "Responses help improve course"
- In-class time: Give 10 minutes during class
- Follow up: Send 2 reminders max

### Acting on Feedback
1. Review results within 1 week
2. Share key findings with students
3. Explain actions you'll take
4. Implement changes in next semester
5. Close the loop: "Based on your feedback..."

## Common Survey Templates

### Course Evaluation
1. Content quality (1-5)
2. Teaching effectiveness (1-5)
3. Assignments relevance (1-5)
4. Fair grading (Yes/No)
5. What worked well? (Text)
6. What needs improvement? (Text)

### Teaching Method Feedback
1. Lecture clarity (1-5)
2. Preferred learning style (Multiple choice)
3. Pace of class (Too slow/Just right/Too fast)
4. Use of examples (1-5)
5. Suggestions for improvement (Text)

### Online Learning Assessment
1. Platform ease of use (1-5)
2. Technical issues encountered (Checkboxes)
3. Prefer online or in-person? (Choice)
4. Quality of recordings (1-5)
5. Additional resources needed (Text)

## Privacy & Ethics

- Anonymous surveys: No names collected
- Aggregate results: Minimum 5 responses to show
- Confidentiality: Individual responses not shared
- Optional participation: No grade penalty
- Data retention: Deleted after 2 years

## Troubleshooting

**Students not receiving survey?**
- Check target audience settings
- Verify student emails in system
- Check spam filters
- Resend manually

**Low response rates?**
- Send reminder
- Mention in class
- Extend deadline
- Make required (if appropriate)

**Can't edit published survey?**
- Create new version
- Close old survey
- Notify students of change

## Advanced Features

### Conditional Logic
- Show/hide questions based on previous answers
- Example: If rating < 3, ask "What went wrong?"

### Branching
- Different paths through survey
- Personalized experience

### Integration
- Auto-create survey from template
- Link to course gradebook
- Export to analytics dashboard

title: Resource Management: Managing Materials and Equipment
content:
## Resource Management Overview

Manage course materials, equipment, rooms, and other resources efficiently.

## Course Materials

### Uploading Documents
1. Resources → Course Materials
2. Select Course
3. Click "Upload"
4. Choose files (PDF, DOC, PPT, ZIP up to 100MB)
5. Add:
   - Title
   - Description
   - Category (Lecture Notes, Assignments, Solutions, etc.)
   - Access Level (All students, Specific group, etc.)
6. Click "Save"

### Organizing Materials
- Create folders by week or topic
- Use consistent naming: "Week 1 - Introduction to Programming.pdf"
- Tag materials with keywords
- Set visibility dates (available from/until)

### Sharing with Students
- Public: All students in course see immediately
- Group-specific: Only selected group
- Scheduled release: Available from specific date
- Link sharing: Generate shareable link

### Version Control
- Upload new version: Keeps history
- Students notified of updates
- Old versions archived (accessible for 30 days)

## Equipment Management

### Available Equipment
- Projectors
- Laptops
- Lab equipment (microscopes, tools, etc.)
- Cameras and recording devices
- Tablets
- Conference room equipment

### Reserving Equipment
1. Resources → Equipment
2. Select item
3. Click "Reserve"
4. Choose:
   - Date and time
   - Duration
   - Purpose
   - Pickup location
5. Submit request
6. Receive confirmation email

### Equipment Checkout
- Show confirmation email at pickup
- Sign equipment log
- Inspect condition (note any damage)
- Return by due date to avoid late fees

### Reporting Issues
- Damaged equipment: Report immediately
- Missing items: Contact equipment office
- Malfunction: Submit support ticket

## Room Booking

### Booking a Room
1. Resources → Rooms
2. Filter by:
   - Capacity needed
   - Equipment (projector, whiteboard, etc.)
   - Building/floor
   - Date/time
3. Select room from available options
4. Enter:
   - Purpose (lecture, meeting, exam, etc.)
   - Expected attendance
   - Setup requirements
5. Submit booking

### Recurring Bookings
- For weekly classes
- Select "Repeat weekly"
- Choose end date
- System blocks all instances

### Modifying Bookings
- Edit up to 24 hours before
- Cancel: Frees room for others
- Late changes: Contact room coordinator

## Digital Resources

### Video Lectures
- Upload to MAIS (up to 2GB)
- Or link to YouTube/Vimeo
- Add captions for accessibility
- Track view statistics

### External Links
- Link to online tools, simulators
- Add description and access instructions
- Check links regularly (broken link alerts)

### Interactive Content
- Embed quizzes
- Link to coding playgrounds
- Share collaborative documents (Google Docs, etc.)

## Library Integration

### Recommended Reading
- Link to library catalog
- Mark as required or optional
- Students see availability status

### E-Books and Journals
- Direct links to digital library
- Access via university login
- Copyright compliance

## Analytics

### Usage Statistics
- Most downloaded materials
- Engagement rates
- Time spent on videos
- Peak access times

### Student Feedback
- Rate materials (helpful/not helpful)
- Comments and questions
- Request additional resources

## Best Practices

1. **Organize by Week/Topic**: Makes it easy for students to find
2. **Name Files Clearly**: "Lecture_1_Introduction.pdf" not "Lec1.pdf"
3. **Upload in Advance**: At least 24 hours before class
4. **Provide Multiple Formats**: PDF for reading, PPT for review
5. **Archive Old Materials**: Keep course page clean
6. **Check Accessibility**: Use screen reader-friendly PDFs
7. **Update Regularly**: Review and refresh each semester

## File Size Limits

- Individual file: 100MB
- Total per course: 5GB
- Videos: 2GB (use external hosting for larger)
- Compress when possible

## Copyright and Legal

- Only upload materials you have rights to
- Provide citations for copyrighted works
- Fair use for educational purposes
- Remove materials if requested by publisher

## Troubleshooting

**Upload fails?**
- Check file size (under 100MB)
- Verify file format supported
- Try different browser
- Clear cache and retry

**Students can't access?**
- Check visibility settings
- Verify release date
- Confirm student in correct group
- Check file permissions

**Room booking conflict?**
- Contact room coordinator
- Check for manual bookings not in system
- Propose alternative time
- Use conflict resolution tool

title: Class Schedule Management: Creating and Managing Timetables
content:
## Schedule Management

Manage class schedules, timetables, and calendar events.

## Viewing Your Schedule

### Daily View
- See today's classes
- Time, room, and course info
- Click for details

### Weekly View
- Mon-Fri grid layout
- Color-coded by course
- Drag to reschedule (if permitted)

### Monthly Calendar
- Overview of entire month
- Exam dates highlighted
- Holidays and breaks marked

### Export Options
- **iCal**: Import to Apple Calendar, Google Calendar
- **PDF**: Print your schedule
- **Image**: Share as screenshot

## Creating Schedule Events (Teachers)

### Regular Class
1. Schedule → "Add Class"
2. Select:
   - Course code
   - Day of week
   - Time slot
   - Room
   - Class group
3. Choose recurrence:
   - Weekly (default)
   - Bi-weekly (every other week)
   - One-time
4. Set semester dates
5. Save

### Special Events
- Guest lectures
- Field trips
- Review sessions
- Office hours
- Exam times

Same process, mark as "Special Event"

## Managing Conflicts

### Automatic Detection
- System alerts to conflicts:
  - Room double-booked
  - Teacher scheduled twice at same time
  - Student group overlap

### Resolving Conflicts
1. Review conflict details
2. Choose resolution:
   - Change time
   - Change room
   - Split group
   - Cancel one event
3. System updates all affected parties

## Room Assignment

### Automatic Assignment
- System suggests rooms based on:
  - Capacity needed
  - Equipment requirements
  - Building preference
  - Availability

### Manual Assignment
- Browse available rooms
- Filter by features
- Select and confirm

### Room Changes
- Up to 24 hours before: Edit directly
- Less than 24 hours: Request approval
- Day-of changes: Contact coordinator
- Students notified automatically

## Cancellations and Make-ups

### Cancelling a Class
1. Select class in schedule
2. Click "Cancel"
3. Enter reason
4. Select notification method:
   - Email
   - SMS
   - App notification
   - All
5. Confirm

### Scheduling Make-up
1. After cancelling, click "Schedule Make-up"
2. Find available time for all students
3. Propose 2-3 options
4. Poll students for best time
5. Finalize based on majority

## Notifications

### Automatic Notifications
Students notified for:
- New classes scheduled
- Time/room changes
- Cancellations
- Make-up classes
- Exam schedules

### Reminder Settings
- Day before: "Tomorrow you have..."
- 1 hour before: "Starting soon..."
- Morning digest: "Today's schedule"

Configure in Settings → Notifications

## Integration

### Calendar Sync
- Two-way sync with Google/Outlook
- Updates reflect in both systems
- Color coding preserved

### Mobile App
- View schedule offline
- Get push notifications
- Quick room navigation

## Special Scenarios

### Exam Periods
- Separate exam schedule
- Longer time blocks
- Multiple rooms for large groups
- Staggered start times

### Hybrid/Online Classes
- Mark class as "Online"
- Add video link (Zoom, Teams, etc.)
- Students see link 15 minutes before class

### Lab Sessions
- Link to equipment reservations
- Safety protocols attached
- TA assignments

## Tips for Teachers

1. **Set Regular Office Hours**: Helps students plan
2. **Book Rooms Early**: Popular rooms fill up
3. **Use Consistent Times**: e.g., always Tue/Thu 10:00
4. **Plan Make-ups in Advance**: Before cancelling
5. **Check Room Features**: Projector, computers, etc.
6. **Notify Early**: Give students 24+ hour notice

## For Students

1. **Sync to Personal Calendar**: Never miss a class
2. **Set Reminders**: 15 minutes before class
3. **Check Daily**: Room changes can happen
4. **Report Conflicts**: If you have overlapping classes
5. **Use Map Feature**: Find unfamiliar rooms

## Accessibility Features

- Room wheelchair accessibility indicated
- Hearing loop availability
- Elevator access marked
- Request accommodations via profile

## Troubleshooting

**Schedule not syncing?**
- Reauthorize calendar integration
- Check privacy settings
- Ensure internet connection
- Try manual refresh

**Room not available?**
- Check if it's exam period
- Look for holiday closures
- Verify room capacity
- Contact room coordinator

**Can't find a class?**
- Check if you're enrolled
- Verify semester dates
- Look in "Cancelled" filter
- Contact course coordinator

title: Common Issues and Troubleshooting
content:
## General Troubleshooting

### Can't Log In

**Check:**
1. Username is your university email
2. Password is case-sensitive
3. Caps Lock is off
4. No extra spaces

**Reset Password:**
1. Click "Forgot Password" on login page
2. Enter your email
3. Check email (and spam folder)
4. Click reset link (expires in 1 hour)
5. Create new password (min 8 characters)

**Still Can't Access?**
- Contact IT Help Desk: it@mais.sk
- Call: +421 (0)55 602 xxxx
- Visit: IT Office, Building X, Room 123

### Page Not Loading

**Quick Fixes:**
1. Refresh page (Ctrl+R or Cmd+R)
2. Clear browser cache:
   - Chrome: Ctrl+Shift+Delete
   - Firefox: Ctrl+Shift+Del
   - Safari: Cmd+Option+E
3. Try incognito/private mode
4. Try different browser
5. Check internet connection

**Still Not Working?**
- Run Diagnostics (Help → Diagnostics)
- Check System Status page
- Report issue via Bug Reporter

### Data Not Saving

**Checklist:**
- Internet connection stable?
- Session still active? (auto-logs out after 2 hours idle)
- Browser allows cookies?
- No ad blockers interfering?
- File size within limits?

**Solution:**
- Save work frequently
- Enable auto-save in Settings
- Use "Download Support Bundle" before reporting

### Slow Performance

**Possible Causes:**
1. Too many tabs open (close unused ones)
2. Browser cache full (clear it)
3. Slow internet connection (check speed)
4. System maintenance (check status page)
5. Large file uploads (compress files)

**Speed It Up:**
- Use modern browser (Chrome 90+, Firefox 88+, Safari 14+)
- Disable unnecessary extensions
- Close other apps
- Restart browser
- Try wired connection instead of WiFi

## Feature-Specific Issues

### Grades Not Showing

**For Students:**
- Teacher hasn't submitted yet
- Check "Pending" tab
- Refresh page
- Verify correct semester selected

**For Teachers:**
- Grades need to be "Published"
- Check course and group filters
- Ensure student enrolled
- Contact registrar if student missing

### Attendance Not Recording

**Check:**
- Correct date selected
- Right course/group chosen
- Student in attendance list
- Click "Save" after marking

**If Student Missing:**
- Student might not be enrolled
- Check with registrar
- Add student to roster first

### Chat Messages Not Sending

**Troubleshoot:**
1. Check if recipient blocked you
2. Verify internet connection
3. Check file size (attachments < 25MB)
4. Try plain text (remove formatting)
5. Refresh page and retry

**Alternative:**
- Send email instead
- Use "Offline Message" (queues for later)

### Files Not Uploading

**Common Issues:**
- File too large (check limits)
- Unsupported file type
- Filename has special characters
- No storage space left

**Solutions:**
- Compress large files (use ZIP)
- Rename file (use only letters, numbers, hyphens)
- Free up space (delete old files)
- Split into smaller files

## Mobile App Issues

### App Crashing
1. Force close app
2. Clear app cache
3. Update to latest version
4. Restart phone
5. Reinstall app

### Notifications Not Working

**iOS:**
- Settings → MAIS → Notifications → Allow
- Check Do Not Disturb mode
- Check notification settings in MAIS app

**Android:**
- Settings → Apps → MAIS → Notifications → Enable
- Check battery optimization (disable for MAIS)
- Ensure background data allowed

### Sync Issues

- Check internet connection
- Pull down to refresh
- Log out and log back in
- Verify account settings
- Check server status

## Browser Compatibility

### Recommended Browsers
- **Chrome**: 90 or later
- **Firefox**: 88 or later
- **Safari**: 14 or later
- **Edge**: 90 or later

### Not Supported
- Internet Explorer (any version)
- Opera Mini
- UC Browser
- Very old browsers (update!)

## Accessibility Issues

### Screen Reader Not Working

- MAIS supports NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver
- Enable screen reader mode in Settings
- Check ARIA labels present
- Report missing labels via Bug Reporter

### Keyboard Navigation

- Tab through elements
- Enter to activate
- Escape to close modals
- Arrow keys for dropdowns
- Report keyboard traps

## Getting Help

### Self-Service
1. Search Knowledge Base (you're here!)
2. Check Changelog for recent updates
3. Run Diagnostics
4. Review Shortcuts

### Support Channels

**Help Desk**
- Email: support@mais.sk
- Phone: +421 (0)55 602 xxxx
- Hours: Mon-Fri 8:00-16:00
- Response time: 24-48 hours

**Live Chat**
- Click chat icon (bottom right)
- Mon-Fri 9:00-15:00
- Avg wait: 5 minutes

**Submit Ticket**
1. Help → "Report a Bug"
2. Fill out form
3. Attach screenshots
4. Include diagnostics
5. Submit
6. Track via email

**Emergency (System Down)**
- Call IT emergency: +421 (0)55 602 xxxx
- Check Twitter: @MAISsupport
- Status page: status.mais.sk

### What to Include in Bug Reports

1. **Steps to reproduce**:
   - What you were doing
   - What you clicked
   - What you expected

2. **Environment**:
   - Browser and version
   - Operating system
   - Screen size

3. **Evidence**:
   - Screenshots
   - Error messages (exact text)
   - Diagnostics output

4. **Impact**:
   - How urgent is it?
   - Is there a workaround?
   - Who else is affected?

## Preventive Measures

1. **Keep Browser Updated**: Auto-update enabled
2. **Regular Backups**: Export important data
3. **Use Strong Password**: Change every 6 months
4. **Enable 2FA**: Extra security layer
5. **Check Email**: Don't miss system notifications
6. **Clear Cache Monthly**: Prevents buildup
7. **Report Issues Early**: Before they worsen

## Known Issues

Check Changelog for:
- Current known bugs
- Workarounds available
- Expected fix dates
- Feature limitations

## System Maintenance

**Scheduled Maintenance**:
- Every Saturday 2:00-4:00 AM
- System read-only during this time
- Notifications sent 48 hours in advance
- Check status page for updates

**Emergency Maintenance**:
- Announced via email/app
- Usually completed within 2 hours
- Check Twitter for real-time updates

title: Keyboard Shortcuts and Quick Navigation
content:
## Keyboard Shortcuts

Master these shortcuts to navigate MAIS efficiently!

## Global Shortcuts

**Navigation:**
- Cmd/Ctrl + K: Open Command Palette
- g then a: Go to Activities
- g then p: Go to Profile
- f: Go to Faculty Management
- Esc: Close modals/dropdowns

**Actions:**
- Cmd/Ctrl + S: Save (when editing)
- Cmd/Ctrl + Enter: Submit form
- Cmd/Ctrl + /: Focus search box
- ?: Show shortcuts help

## Command Palette

Press Cmd/Ctrl + K to open, then type:

- students → Student Management
- grades → Grade Management
- attendance → Attendance Tracking
- chat → Chat Center
- help → Help & Support
- profile → Your Profile
- schedule → Class Schedule
- resources → Resource Management

Just start typing, no need to click!

## Page-Specific Shortcuts

### Grade Management
- Tab: Next student
- Shift + Tab: Previous student
- Enter: Save grade
- Cmd/Ctrl + F: Find student

### Attendance
- P: Mark Present
- A: Mark Absent
- L: Mark Late
- E: Mark Excused
- Down Arrow: Next student
- Up Arrow: Previous student

### Chat
- Cmd/Ctrl + Enter: Send message
- Cmd/Ctrl + U: Upload file
- @: Mention someone
- Cmd/Ctrl + F: Search messages
- Esc: Close chat

### Student Management
- Cmd/Ctrl + N: New student
- Cmd/Ctrl + E: Edit selected
- Delete: Remove selected (with confirmation)
- Cmd/Ctrl + P: Print list

## Accessibility Shortcuts

- Tab: Navigate through elements
- Shift + Tab: Navigate backwards
- Enter/Space: Activate buttons
- Escape: Cancel/Close
- Arrow keys: Navigate dropdowns

## Tips

1. Learn gradually: Start with Command Palette, add more over time
2. Hover for hints: Many buttons show shortcuts
3. Customize: Some shortcuts can be changed in Settings
4. Practice: Use shortcuts daily to build muscle memory
5. Share: Teach shortcuts to colleagues and students

## Browser Shortcuts (Still Useful)

- Cmd/Ctrl + R: Refresh page
- Cmd/Ctrl + T: New tab
- Cmd/Ctrl + W: Close tab
- Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + T: Reopen closed tab
- Cmd/Ctrl + L: Focus address bar
- Cmd/Ctrl + +: Zoom in
- Cmd/Ctrl + -: Zoom out
- Cmd/Ctrl + 0: Reset zoom

## Power User Combo

Morning Routine:
1. Cmd/Ctrl + K → dashboard
2. g a → Check activities
3. Cmd/Ctrl + K → chat → Check messages
4. g p → Review profile/schedule

Time saved: ~2 minutes per day = 8+ hours per year!
